component_graph.raw_cluster_id_use: opaque provenance only; never used for ranking, ties, or semantic output hashes

rules.background: border-touching components are provisional BG; non-border foreground candidates cannot overwrite them
rules.lv_myo: rank MYO plus grouped LV hypotheses using enclosure boundary support and relative area
rules.rv: rank connected groups of MYO-adjacent components using normalized group boundary contact
rules.conflicts: a best-hypothesis label is VOID only when a near-optimal hypothesis assigns that same component a different semantic role; absence from another hypothesis is not a conflict

intensity_policy.reason: central_image is bound but intensity is not used until separately calibrated

orientation_policy.reason: shared geometry does not establish a common short-axis direction

void_policy.validity_encoding: boolean; true iff semantic encoding is not VOID
